urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Page URLs to check (https:// is added when missing). Duplicates are skipped.

urlsText.title: URLs as text
urlsText.description: Optional. Paste a column of URLs separated by new lines, spaces or commas.

includeSecurityHeaders.title: Include security headers
includeSecurityHeaders.description: Add HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy to each row.

maxRedirects.title: Max redirects to follow
maxRedirects.description: Redirect hops followed and recorded in redirectChain.

includeFailed.title: Keep unreachable URLs in the dataset
includeFailed.description: URLs with no HTTP response at all (DNS failure, timeout) are free. Turn on to still list them with an error.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per URL (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a URL after this many seconds.
